semiconductor_relevance: High — Nishimura Chemitech provides essential chemicals and equipment for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Nishimura Chemitech specializes in the sales and maintenance of chemical solutions and equipment used in semiconductor fabrication, including chemical delivery systems and incidental equipment. The company also offers inspection subcontracting and technical guidance for semiconductor and electronic equipment.
capabilities: Sales of surface treatment related chemicals and equipment materials
Design and manufacturing of chemical delivery equipment
Sales and maintenance of chemical solution dilution mixers for CMP tools
Inspection subcontracting for semiconductor and FPD equipment

regional_presence.Japan: Nishimura Chemitech operates extensively across Japan, serving the semiconductor and electronic device markets.
regional_presence.Southeast Asia: The company has established business bases in Singapore and Taiwan to expand its market presence.
